title: Getting around with a T-money card
caption:
One card for the subway, buses and taxis.
Buy it, top it up, tap in and out, and get your change back before you fly.
Save this for your first day in Seoul.
Details & official links in bio.
#Seoul #KoreaTravel #TMoney #SeoulSubway #TravelTips

slides.heading: One card for every ride
slides.body: How to buy, top up and use T-money (티머니) on subways, buses and taxis.

slides.heading: Buy one at a convenience store
slides.body: GS25, CU and 7-Eleven sell T-money cards at the counter. Subway station vending machines do too.

slides.heading: Top up with cash
slides.body: Ask at the counter, or use the recharge machine in any subway station. Most machines take cash only.

slides.heading: Tap in and tap out
slides.body: Tap the reader when you get on and when you get off, on buses too. Tapping out gets you the transfer discount.

slides.heading: Transfers within 30 minutes
slides.body: Switch between subway and bus within 30 minutes and you only pay for the extra distance.

slides.heading: Before your first ride
slides.body:
Card from a convenience store
Cash for topping up
Tap out every time

slides.heading: Save this for your first day
slides.body: Send it to the friend who always loses their subway ticket.
